question: Will Spotify name a non-US artist its most-streamed artist worldwide in Wrapped 2026?
detail: Resolves YES if Spotify's official 2026 Wrapped announcement lists a non-US artist as the top global artist. Resolves NO if the top artist is from the US.

question: Will a song mostly in a language other than English hit #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 during 2027?
detail: Resolves YES if any Billboard Hot 100 chart dated in 2027 has a song sung mostly in a language other than English at #1.

question: Will Bad Bunny release a new studio album before July 1, 2027?
detail: A full-length studio album under his own name, released on streaming services before July 1, 2027. EPs, singles and deluxe editions do not count.

question: Will Frank Ocean release a new studio album before the end of 2027?
detail: A full-length studio album released on major streaming services by December 31, 2027.

question: Will an Afrobeats act headline a night at Coachella, Lollapalooza or Governors Ball in 2027?
detail: Resolves YES if a Nigerian or Ghanaian Afrobeats artist is billed as a headliner for any single night of those festivals' 2027 editions.

question: Will a K-pop act top the Billboard 200 at least once in 2027?
detail: Resolves YES if any Billboard 200 chart dated in 2027 has a K-pop group or soloist at #1.
